metadata.intermediate_72_rule_design: 72 unique alerts expanded to 165 via three-tier (info/warning/critical) per metric

threshold_changes.notes: Info tier at 65% per optimization report (was 50% initially in LCK-RD-001 design). Two duplicate old rules (ALR-019/020) merged. ALR-020 eliminated as duplicate PromQL.

Changed from absolute count (>300 in 3min) to rate-based (per minute). Three Grafana duplicates (ALR-133/134/135) and one PromQL duplicate (ALR-026) eliminated. New metric uses rate(mysql_global_status_slow_queries[5m]) * 60.
Optimization report raised from 12/24/48 to 25/50/100. Old system had only one level at >24. Two duplicate old rules (ALR-027/028) merged.
Converted from pure absolute (<10GB) to percentage-based with absolute fallback. Addresses instance size inconsistency (10GB = 37% on small vs 1.5% on large).
ALR-022 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Added graduated response: 30s info (probe failure), 45s warning (possible failover), 1m critical (confirmed outage).
ALR-024 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. New system adds warning tier for abnormally long failover (>2 min). Info tier captures event for logging.
Critical gap identified after isalescdp OOM failover (2026-03-12). FreeableMemory dropped to 82-102MB with no alert. Percentage + absolute fallback for size-agnostic detection.
Critical gap. isalescdp SwapUsage reached 530MB before OOM. Any swap usage on RDS indicates memory pressure.
New alert for read replica lag. Affects read-write splitting consistency.
Old ALR-050 was generic (all exporters). New system has dedicated RDS exporter alert with graduated duration. Prevents monitoring blind spots.
Added info at 50%. Warning threshold unchanged at 70% but duration changed from 3m to 5m. Critical at 90% with 3m duration added.

Optimization report noted isales-market incident: 61%->87% in 20 min. Recommended 75% warning but new YAML uses 80%. Added absolute fallback for small instances. Critical at 95% with just 1m duration for fast response.
Changed from average latency to P99. Optimization report recommended lowering warning to 2ms (from 5ms in intermediate design). Redis should respond in microseconds; 5ms is already severe.
Old rule triggered on ANY eviction (>0 in 5min). New system uses rate-based thresholds to distinguish incidental vs significant vs catastrophic eviction.
Old 30% threshold was too aggressive for production. Raised info to 50%, warning to 70%, critical at 90%. Added duration requirements.
Two separate alerts (buffer + bandwidth) merged into unified network bandwidth alert. Added info tier at 20Mbps and critical at 50Mbps.
Blocked clients signal merged into Redis connection health alert (LCK-RE-008). No longer a standalone alert.
Old rule had no duration (instant trigger). New system adds graduated duration to avoid alert on brief network blips.
Dedicated Redis exporter health alert. Old system had only generic exporter alert (ALR-050).
ALR-036 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Critical duration changed from 0m (instant) to 1m per optimization report to filter <1min transient RED (luckycommon incident).
Added 5m duration to yellow warning. Old system had instant trigger. Info tier covers any non-Green state.
ALR-034 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Warning lowered from 90% to 75%, critical set at 85% (was 90%). Added info at 60%. Added duration requirements (old was instant).
ALR-039 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Converted from absolute 10GB to percentage-based. Added three tiers with duration. Info includes absolute fallback at 20GB.
New metric for ES JVM heap pressure. Critical at 92% to prevent GC storms.
ALR-031 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Added info (50%) and warning (70%) tiers. Critical unchanged at 90%.
Optimization report added percentage-based version alongside absolute. Critical at <200MB is new split from ALR-032. Added percentage thresholds at 20%/10%.
New alert for MongoDB connection saturation. Uses connection count / max ratio.

Thresholds preserved but severity reclassified. Old system had ALL pod CPU alerts at P0 (instant escalation). New system properly tiers: 50% is info, 70% is warning, 85% is critical. Warning duration extended from 3m to 5m.
Downgraded from P0 to warning. A single pod restart does not warrant critical-level phone calls. Inhibited by OOMKilled critical.
Upgraded from P1 to critical. OOM is always a critical event requiring immediate attention.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: Write >50MB/s or Read >50MB/s or NetIn >30MB/s or NetOut >30MB/s for 3min
threshold_changes.notes: Four separate alerts (write/read/net-in/net-out) merged into single IO alert. Downgraded from P0 to warning — disk IO alone rarely needs immediate phone call.
Added 5m duration. Old system triggered instantly on any heartbeat miss. New inhibition rule: node-down suppresses all pod alerts on same node.
New alert per optimization report (K8S-08). Monitors Kubernetes node conditions directly.
New alert per optimization report (K8S-09). Monitors Kubernetes node conditions directly.
Thread count alert merged into pod CPU critical alert. High thread count correlates with CPU saturation.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-100: load>cores 5min, ALR-101: >80%, ALR-102: iowait>80%, ALR-103: steal>10%, ALR-106: IO>90ms, ALR-107: IO>70%
threshold_changes.notes: Six separate alerts consolidated into warning + critical tiers. CPU warning raised from 80% to match new system. IO-related alerts merged into CPU critical.
Warning lowered from 90% to 85% for earlier detection. Added critical at 95% (OOM imminent).
Warning lowered from 90% to 85% for earlier response. Critical now combines partition, inodes, and read-only into single rule. Added duration requirements.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-110: heartbeat lost 10min, ALR-116: NIC down (instant)
threshold_changes.notes: Two alerts merged into one critical. Instance down is always critical.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-108: TCP retrans >200/s, ALR-112-115: packet drops/errors >20/s
threshold_changes.notes: Five P0 alerts merged into one warning. Network errors alone rarely warrant immediate phone calls — often secondary to other issues.

13 old rules (9 identical iZeus strategy duplicates + 4 default strategy) consolidated into 2. Optimization report changed to ratio-based (>2% with guard clause). Old absolute thresholds caused noise with low traffic.
Four rules merged into one. Optimization report changed to ratio-based (>1% with guard clause). Old >=1 failure/min threshold triggered on any single failure.
Warning threshold kept. New critical tier at 5s per optimization report (APM-03b).

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-069: JVM CPU>20%, ALR-079: FGC>5, ALR-085: FGC>0 or YGC>500ms
threshold_changes.notes: Three alerts merged into single JVM health warning. FGC>0 from ALR-085 raised to FGC>5 (matching ALR-079) to reduce noise.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: Various: CPU>85%, Disk>85%, Memory>95%, pipeline status checks
threshold_changes.notes: Eight iZeus infrastructure alerts (node CPU/disk/memory + 5 pipeline status) merged into single parameterized warning.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-118: <1 order for 10min, ALR-119: <1 payment for 10min
threshold_changes.notes: Old system only had P0 (zero orders = instant max escalation). New system adds graduated response: info at <20, warning at <10, critical at <1. Payment alert merged into order volume.

Converted from absolute (>1 cancellation) to ratio-based (>5/10/25%). Added guard clause requiring >5 orders to avoid false positives during low-traffic hours. Old threshold triggered during normal operations.
Added order volume guard clause to prevent nighttime false positives. Critical at $0 distinguishes complete payment failure from low volume.
Added UTC time exclusion (05:00-11:00 = EST 00:00-06:00) to eliminate nightly false positives. Graduated duration: 10m info, 20m warning, 30m critical.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: NOT MONITORED (no traffic baseline alert existed)
threshold_changes.new_info: Traffic <50% of daily avg same hour for 10m
threshold_changes.new_warning: Traffic <30% of daily avg same hour for 10m
threshold_changes.new_critical: Traffic <10% of daily avg same hour for 5m
threshold_changes.notes: New baseline-relative traffic monitoring. Optimization report split traffic anomaly into drop (warning) vs spike (info only). Uses recording rule for daily average.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: NOT MONITORED (only APM latency existed at ALR-070)
threshold_changes.notes: New business-layer latency alert (order service). Optimization report added critical at >8s (BIZ-10b). Separate from APM-level latency which covers all services.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: Golden: >5m delay, Core: >10m delay, Important: >15m delay, Regular: >30m delay (separate day/night rules)
threshold_changes.new_critical: Golden flow pipeline delay >5m or exception
threshold_changes.notes: 14 alerts (7 day/night pairs) consolidated into 4 by merging day/night variants and using time-based muting. Priority aligned: golden=critical, core=warning, important/standard=info.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: Various: >50/200 failures, <60-70% success, >50-100 filtered, >30% WoW increase
threshold_changes.notes: Nine granular SMS alerts consolidated into single parameterized delivery failure warning. Covers all providers (marketing, transactional, verification) in one rule.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-122/124: pre-warning, ALR-123/125: breaker triggered, ALR-126-130: RPC >200/100 calls AND >60% WoW
threshold_changes.notes: Nine risk control alerts consolidated: 7 pre-warning variants -> 1 warning, 2 breaker triggers -> 1 critical.

threshold_changes.old_threshold: ALR-131: >15% error rate, ALR-132: network probe failure, ALR-050: exporter down
threshold_changes.new_warning: Gateway error rate >5% for 5m (new tier per optimization report PLAT-04b)
threshold_changes.new_critical: Gateway error rate >20% for 3m or network probe failure or exporter down
threshold_changes.notes: Optimization report raised critical from 15% to 20% and added new warning at 5%. Exporter health absorbed into gateway alert. Eliminates gap where 0% jumps directly to 15% critical.
Entirely new metric per optimization report (MSK-01/02). Covers 308 topics across 2 MSK clusters. No previous monitoring of Kafka consumer lag.

old_system.method: Flat priority labels with hardcoded notification
old_system.P0: WeCom text + hardcoded _语音 (Twilio voice call) for critical rules — 41 rules (30%)
old_system.voice_call_rules: 7 duplicate _语音 rules (ALR-022, ALR-024, ALR-031, ALR-034, ALR-036, ALR-039, ALR-050)
old_system.wecom_channels: 1 shared WeCom channel for all severities
old_system.muting: None — all alerts fire 24/7 regardless of time

new_system.method: Severity-label-based Alertmanager routing with unified notification pipeline

info.muting: Muted during us-offhours-non-biz (07:00-12:00 UTC / 2-7 AM ET weekdays)

warning.channel: WeCom warning channel + Twilio (team lead US number only)
warning.voice_call: Team lead only via webhook proxy localhost:9097/twilio/call
warning.muting: Muted during us-offhours-non-biz (07:00-12:00 UTC / 2-7 AM ET weekdays)

critical.channel: WeCom critical channel + Twilio (ALL DevOps US + China)
critical.voice_call: All DevOps (US + China) via webhook proxy localhost:9097/twilio/call-all

izeus_webhook.purpose: ALL alerts forwarded for APM correlation

inhibition_rules: Critical suppresses warning + info on same alertname + service
Node-down suppresses all pod alerts on same node
Instance-down suppresses all service alerts on same instance

time_intervals.name: us-offhours-non-biz
time_intervals.exemptions: BIZ alerts and critical alerts are NEVER muted

time_intervals.name: nightly_batch_window (proposed)
time_intervals.exemptions: Warning and Critical tiers not affected

improvements: Unified Twilio routing via Alertmanager receiver config instead of per-rule duplication
Added time-based muting (07:00-12:00 UTC weekdays for info/warning)
iZeus webhook receives ALL alerts via continue:true for APM correlation
3 separate WeCom channels (info/warning/critical) vs 1 shared channel
Severity cascade inhibition: critical suppresses warning+info for same alert+service
Node-down inhibits all pod alerts on same node (prevents alert storms)
Instance-down inhibits all service alerts on same instance
Graduated repeat intervals: info=4h, warning=1h, critical=15m (old system: flat)
Graduated group_wait: info=60s, warning=30s, critical=15s (faster escalation for critical)
send_resolved: true on all WeCom channels (resolution notifications)
Nightly batch window (04:30-06:30 UTC) proposed to silence predictable spikes
Estimated noise reduction: 50-60% fewer pages per incident
